intended_use: Research report on one virtual patient (Wang et al. 2025 P2): EZ-recovery and virtual-intervention ranking with an unqualified, exploratory model. Not a clinical recommendation.
reason: Most numbers trace correctly: RES-EZ+PZ ablation median -3.0 [-4.9,-1.55] regions, 41.7% abolished (5/12), STIM-1/STIM-2 -0.5 to -1.0, finite pulse-train arms median 0 (A0038 payload results.full, recomputed in A0041); recall 0 in all four estimates, true-EZ rank by median x0 159/46/133/62 of 162, true model 0 seizing regions in both variants, full-window sign agreement 9/18, freeze seq 205 and reveal seq 214 (A0043/A0044); A0040 Pathfinder arm A P(EZ rank 1) 0.012 and NUTS did not finish warm-up. Exploratory status and the no-clinical-recommendation statement are clear. These items need correction or disclosure: (1) Imprecise benchmark numbers. A0037 arm A ranked the planted EZ 2nd with max x0 R-hat 4.73. Arm B ranked it 6th with R-hat 4.91 (A0037 convergence_checks; A0042). 'R-hat up to 4.7' understates the maximum. (2) Overstated reproducibility. A0041 reran 1 sample x 6 arms bit-exactly, not all of A0038. 'Every simulation was reproducible' (lessons item 3) and 'reproduced bit-exactly by R5' are not supported at that scope. (3) Undisclosed window. The effects reported are from the full window, which A0038 treats as a sensitivity window (12 of 24 optima, the 12 highest-lp, chosen before simulation). In the primary post window there were no baseline seizures in any of 24 optima, so the ranking there is uninformative and frac_abolish_all=1.0 is vacuous. The report gives the full-window effects without saying this. (4) Missing R5 gate status. R5 gated A0038 indeterminate because its numerical check was not clean, and failed A0018, A0019, A0037, A0040, A0014 and A0039 (A0042). The report and bundle do not state these gate verdicts. (5) Undisclosed failed check. The fitted model's qualitative baseline check against the recording failed in both windows: 0/10 top-channel overlap (A0038 limitations and qualitative_check_vs_recording). The report does not say so. (6) Numerical-failure counts. These are not given: full window STIM-PT/amp2 2/12, STIM-PT/amp4 9/12, chronic amp2 10/12 and chronic amp4 12/12 runs non-finite; post window amp4 arms 24/24 and 23/24. (7) Unsupported claim. The P2 seizure duration of '~4 s' cites no artifact. Cite the source or mark it to_verify. (8) Incomplete reproducibility manifest. The A0045 reproducibility_manifest omits artifacts the dossier relies on: A0017, A0018, A0019, A0037, A0038 and A0040. A0038 is covered by the prediction_freeze hash only. (9) Minor, optional: A0043 shows the true EZ was listed as a propagation-zone candidate of H1 (A0017). Mention it for completeness.
acceptance_checks: A0037 described as: arm A planted EZ rank 2, max x0 R-hat 4.73; arm B rank 6, R-hat 4.91 (all 162 x0 R-hat >= 1.05)
A0040 P(EZ rank 1) 0.012 attributed to Pathfinder arm A (arm B: EZ rank 28, P 0.205)
Reproducibility claim scoped to A0041: 6/6 runs (1 sample x 6 arms) bit-exact; 'every simulation was reproducible' removed or qualified
Report and bundle state that reported effects come from the full (sensitivity) window, 12 of 24 optima, and that the primary post window had no baseline seizures (ranking uninformative)
R5 gate verdicts stated: A0038 indeterminate (numerical check not clean); A0018/A0019/A0037/A0040/A0014/A0039 failed
Failed qualitative baseline check vs recording (0/10 top-channel overlap) listed in limitations
Non-finite run counts per pulse-train arm stated, or cited to A0038 numerically_failed_arms
'~4 s' seizure duration cited to an artifact or marked to_verify
A0045 reproducibility_manifest includes manifest hashes for A0017, A0018, A0019, A0037, A0038 and A0040
Revised A0045/A0046 committed with --supersedes; all other numbers unchanged; the exploratory, virtual-patient, and not-a-clinical-recommendation wording kept
